arguments.summary: The 502s on the checkout page were due to an ingress idle timeout of 30 seconds, not a database issue. The cron drift was due to a misunderstanding of UTC scheduling. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing, with 1388 failed jobs and 47 malformed rows. Using the ORM exporter for the failed_jobs table caused issues, so pg_dump was used instead.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate the reasons for the failed jobs, address any issues, and process the backlog. The failed_jobs table has been exported for the postmortem.
